items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer and Anne Phillips as the interviewee. No personal relationship or interaction beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Anne was interviewed via Zoom on February 24, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Anne Phillips with me today. And I won’t do a complete introduction because that would take too long. So I’ll say vocalist, composer, producer, and a general survivor of the music business.
